source_summary: Pastoral Chinese ink-and-color landscape with a shallow waterway, reeds and banks, two flying birds, a half-submerged water buffalo, a boy riding another buffalo, and a gnarled tree with roots on the right; seals and border areas are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: flying_bird_pair
motifs.description: Isolate the two dark birds flying across the open upper sky, including both silhouettes and wing feather strokes only.
must_preserve: dark ink silhouettes with tapered wings
individual feather-line strokes on raised and lowered wings
small pointed beaks and forked tail shapes
subtle variation between the two birds' poses

motifs.name: misted_far_shoreline
motifs.description: Isolate the pale horizontal far bank and mist wash running across the middle distance, without including seals or foreground animals.
must_preserve: soft gray-brown wash band
blurred mist edges along the bank
thin wavering contour line at the shore
faint tonal transition into open water below

motifs.name: central_reed_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the tall reed and grass cluster rising from the left-center bank, including the thin stalks and sparse leaf blades, but excluding the nearby buffalo.
must_preserve: fine black reed stalks crossing at varied angles
pale green-gray washes at the base
delicate needle-like leaf strokes
uneven density from sparse upper tips to heavier lower clump

motifs.name: half_submerged_buffalo
motifs.description: Isolate the water buffalo partly submerged near the left-center water, including head, horns, back, shoulder, and visible watery body contours.
must_preserve: curved crescent horns with dark ink edges
rounded muzzle, eye, and nostril details
soft brown-gray body wash fading into water
submerged back and neck contours
thin ripple lines touching the body

motifs.name: right_gnarled_tree_and_roots
motifs.description: Isolate the gnarled tree trunk, exposed roots, rocky right bank, and adjacent low shrubs, avoiding the red seals above.
must_preserve: twisted trunk contour lines
dark root outlines gripping the bank
dry-brush bark texture and knots
small dotted shrubs and grass tufts
rock ledge wash and rough edge texture

motifs.name: boy_riding_buffalo
motifs.description: Isolate the large walking water buffalo with the seated boy rider in the lower right, including the boy's garment lines, the animal's horns, legs, tail, and body wash.
must_preserve: boy's seated posture and bent legs
fine garment folds in pale ink
boy's head and short hair wash
large buffalo's dark rounded body wash
curved horns, muzzle, eye, and tail
leg and hoof linework with wet-ground contact marks

motifs.name: foreground_grassy_rock_islet
motifs.description: Isolate the low foreground islet of grasses, rocks, and dark scrub beneath the buffalo path, excluding seals and as much of the animal as possible.
must_preserve: tufted grass strokes in clustered arcs
dark ink scrub patches
low rounded rock forms
soft earthy wash around the islet
irregular broken shoreline edge

motifs.name: shallow_water_ripple_field
motifs.description: Isolate the open shallow water area at lower left with layered ripple lines and pale wash, avoiding the red seal and figures.
must_preserve: long thin horizontal ripple strokes
subtle wavering contour lines
pale transparent water wash
spacing variation between ripple bands
quiet empty-water negative space

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
